findings.namedBuyers: Jason Wei Jiang, Jaqueline Zhou, Dennis Jun and Syed Tamzid are listed as Calle Del Tango directors by two public corporate-data directories. They are named organizer-side relationship/referral candidates, not verified festival housing buyers. Prioritize Jason Wei Jiang and Syed Tamzid for referral through the organization, while confirming their actual festival responsibilities. Separately, the official festival biography identifies a first-name-only Jason as a Toronto tango organizer and resident DJ of Milonga Maleva and Milonga Dominguez; his identity as Jason Wei Jiang is not established by that biography. No named person’s hotel contracting authority is published.
findings.futureEdition: Official festival homepage and 2027 venue/accommodation pages publish July 29–August 2, 2027 in Toronto, Canada: actual festival dates, within the requested horizon. Exact 2027 venue remains unpublished. TangoFestivals.net instead ends August 3; use the organizer’s August 2 date. No later edition was identified in the reviewed official material.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications and published event format: a downtown city-hotel lodging partnership for visiting dancers, artists, DJs or the organizing team is more plausible than a resort proposition or exclusive festival buyout. The official festival describes international participation, workshops, performances and milongas, but publishes no attendance, non-local share, peak rooms or room nights. A limited block could suit the 157-room Radisson Blu only after demand, budget, venue access and late-night transport are established; there is no evidence supporting a 15–109-room forecast. The supplied 3,151-sq-ft ballroom is not a verified dance-floor solution: assess sprung/wood flooring, clear dance area, acoustics, hours and workshop layouts before proposing events. Do not assume restaurant, lounge or catering availability.
findings.venueCommitments: 2027 exact venue: null. City: Toronto; region: Ontario; country: Canada. Official Venues · 2027 page says "Coming Soon". Toronto proper is announced, but Harbourfront/downtown/MTCC/Exhibition Place alignment cannot yet be established. Historical 2026 listing names Daniels Spectrum, 585 Dundas Street East, Toronto, Ontario, in Regent Park: a non-hotel cultural venue, not Harbourfront, MTCC or Exhibition Place. Do not carry this address into 2027 as a commitment.
findings.historicalRotation: One historical edition substantiated: 2026, Toronto. Organizer website lists July 30–August 2, 2026; third-party event listings place it at Daniels Spectrum on those dates. Official past-edition artists and 2026 performance pages substantiate the edition. A legacy official DJ page header ends August 3, 2026, creating a historical end-date inconsistency. The 2027 edition is separately announced in Toronto with venue TBD. This supports a return in consecutive years, not an established multi-year annual schedule or destination/venue rotation.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown/unconfirmed. Edition-specific official Accommodation · 2027 page reads "Coming Soon" and "A little anticipation. Something wonderful to look forward to." It names no hotels. No official host hotel, room block, booking code, housing bureau, PCO accommodation mandate or open RFP was identified. Every hotel listed on this accommodation page: none. Silence does not demonstrate open sourcing or that contracts have not been signed privately.
findings.organizationStructure: Calle del Tango presents the festival and describes itself as a Toronto-based community-driven non-profit promoting Argentine tango. Public corporate-data directories identify the same-named federal corporation, incorporated March 9, 2026, with four directors. It is evidenced as a cultural non-profit event presenter, not as a professional association conference, commercial PCO, DMC or housing bureau; no separate agency appointment was identified. Non-profit description is organizer-stated, not an independently inspected legal filing.
findings.competitiveLimitations: No incumbent hotel, sold-out accommodation, overflow requirement or housing exclusivity was found in the reviewed edition-specific material. This is not proof of no competition. Inference: if Regent Park is retained, venue-proximate properties may compete more strongly on convenience than a Harbourfront hotel; the 2027 location must be confirmed before claiming proximity advantage. Attendance is unknown, so the festival cannot responsibly be classified as too large or too small for this hotel.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Email the published festival address info@lapromesatangofestival.com, copying the organizer’s published collaboration inbox info@calledeltango.com, requesting introduction to the person handling 2027 accommodation and artist travel. Ask whether Jason Wei Jiang or Syed Tamzid is the right organizer-side contact; do not represent either as the contracting buyer. First establish the exact venue, any signed housing/venue commitments, all partner hotels, visiting-attendee and artist room requirements by night, target rates and decision date. Only then offer a proportionate lodging block or artist/VIP rooms; assess side events separately after flooring, late-night operations and catering verification. If 2027 is committed, request the next accommodation review date rather than claiming overflow.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The relevant current sales target is the announced 2027 edition, not the completed 2026 event. Public organizer contact is available, but room-block availability, procurement stage and buyer authority are not verified. Treat as relationship-development/qualification accessible only, not an open hotel RFP or confirmed room demand. Homepage registration statements conflict with coming-soon pricing/registration content; registration availability is not used as proof of sales readiness.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: ask to be considered for a 2027 accommodation partnership if arrangements are not committed, or for a later edition if they are. A 2026 historical edition plus a 2027 announcement supports a continuing organizer relationship, but no later dates, rotating-city process or competitive hotel procurement cycle is verified. Do not assume 2028 dates or that the 2026 venue is replaceable.
